events.title: The Previous Owner demo: recorded gameplay
events.summary: A recorded run through the free The Previous Owner demo plays here at set hours during Steam Next Fest, taking turns with our other demos. It is not live, so a question in chat may wait a while. The demo is free on this page.

events.title: Shelve by the rules, and do not read the margins
events.summary: Hello — first word from us on this page. You never met Arthur Pell. The solicitor's letter named you, the will was in order, and the keys work. Above the door, in flaking gold: HERITAGE & SONS — and nobody left alive remembers any sons. Inside: his coat on the hook, his lamp on the counter, a ledger that stops mid-word, and shelving rules too strange to be housekeeping. The Baedeker is never shelved beside the atlases.
